verdict.rationale: Numeral documents vendor-run background automations: Autofile and Autoregister, continuous nexus exposure monitoring, and alerts when a new jurisdiction's nexus is crossed. These run without user intervention, but the evidence shows no way for users to define, configure, or schedule their own automations; the processes are fixed managed services. missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers or recurring schedules, documentation of how automations are set up or controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Continually monitor your business’s exposure in all US and global jurisdictions to identify where you have tax liability.
Get alerts when you cross nexus in new jurisdictions
Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time.
